requirement_text: The system should process user transactions quickly and update the database where appropriate.
suggested_rewrite: The system shall process user transactions within 500 milliseconds and update the transaction database upon successful execution.

requirement_text: Data should be periodically backed up by the system administrator.
suggested_rewrite: The system shall execute an automated encrypted backup of the primary database every 24 hours at 02:00 UTC.

requirement_text: The system shall authenticate user login requests using OAuth 2.0 within 2 seconds of receipt.
The UI must be user-friendly and load pages as fast as possible.
suggested_rewrite: The system shall render web pages within 1.5 seconds on a standard 100 Mbps internet connection.

requirement_text: If an error occurs, the user might be notified if necessary.
suggested_rewrite: The system shall display an error notification modal with an error code and description within 100 milliseconds of an exception.
